description: This file declares the public API for a Manufacturer Wi-Fi software module, including functions for initializing, deinitializing, and managing Wi-Fi credentials.

methods.name: WIFI_Init
methods.description: Initializes the Wi-Fi subsystem and associated data structures.

methods.name: WIFI_DeInit
methods.description: Terminates the Wi-Fi subsystem and releases resources.

methods.name: WIFI_GetCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi credentials into the provided data structure.

methods.name: WIFI_SetCredentials
methods.description: Stores Wi-Fi credentials from the provided data structure.
